content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Ruff Start Rescue's PostRuff Start Rescue Verified accountMarch 23 at 4:00 PM · Shared with PublicHappy National Puppy Day! Celebrated each year on March 23, National Puppy Day was created in 2006 to raise awareness about puppy mills and to encourage people to consider adoption. It’s a day all about celebrating puppies, while also shining a light on those still waiting for homes.And here’s the thing: puppies of every breed, size, and personality can be found in rescue. From tiny fluffballs to big, goofy bundles of energy, there’s no shortage of amazing pups just waiting to meet their people.If you’ve been thinking about adding a puppy to your life, take a look at our currently available cuties: https://ruffstartrescue.org/.../adoptable.../dogs-puppies/+36All reactions:1.3K23 comments199 sharesLikeCommentMost relevant Top fanDonna PetersonCaptain Jack is a Ruff Start Alum3dBob DownsSandy Peterson Downs Lydia Downs check out this line up of cuties!3dTop fanDonna PetersonFlossie is a Ruff Start Alum3dJudy BryanThey are all so adorable!
